sloka: स ताम् दृष्ट्वा महा बाहुर् भूषिताम् मारुत आत्मजः ।तर्कयाम् आस सीता इति रूप यौवन सम्पदा ॥५-१०-५३॥
transliteration: sa tām dṛṣṭvā mahā bāhur bhūṣitām māruta ātmajaḥ ।tarkayām āsa sītā iti rūpa yauvana sampadā ॥5-10-53॥

translations.english: On seeing her embellished with ornaments, beauty and charm, the long armed son of the Windgod, the chief of the vanaras thought her to be Sita and rejoiced.
